emulator: RIPPCSX2 2.9.96-rippcsx2.2 (portable lab copy, its own settings and a new throwaway memory card)
display: Auto NTSC 4:3; native PNG 640x480; unmodified emulator screenshots (F8)
media: 128 MiB MBR/FAT32 USB image (PCSX2 USB mass storage). Sample files generated for these captures: ffmpeg mandelbrot and cellular-automaton test video, sine-tone audio, a subtitle file. No third-party or copyrighted media.
usb_start_steps: Start, Device settings, 14 x Down to 'Start USB support', Cross, Triangle, Triangle
scope: Interface captures only. Not a playback, performance or real-PS2 test.
emulator_limits_seen: Standalone audio did not play in this emulator: MP3 raised an R5900 'Jump to unaligned address' exception; FLAC, OGG and MP2 stopped the display updating.
Every JPEG opened in this emulator showed 'Unsupported or corrupted image'.
